title: UV Index
description: WHO UV Index exposure categories with associated risk and protection advice.

results.risk: Minimal danger from the sun for the average person.
results.protection_advice: No protection needed. You can safely stay outside.

results.risk: Moderate risk of harm from unprotected sun exposure.
results.protection_advice: Seek shade during midday hours; wear sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses.

results.risk: High risk of harm from unprotected sun exposure.
results.protection_advice: Reduce time in the sun between 10am and 4pm; apply SPF 30+ sunscreen, cover up, and wear a hat.

results.risk: Very high risk of harm; unprotected skin can burn quickly.
results.protection_advice: Minimize sun exposure midday; sunscreen, protective clothing, hat, and sunglasses are a must.

results.risk: Extreme risk of harm; unprotected skin can burn in minutes.
results.protection_advice: Avoid the sun midday; take all precautions including shade, clothing, hat, sunglasses, and SPF 30+ sunscreen.
